card.name: Switch to the upper dosing group
card.fires_on: Words or punctuation right after a 'less than' weight or lab range, where the text turns to the other group, such as 'for patients' before '≥' or 'greater than or equal to'.

modes.label: Start of second weight group
modes.description: A bullet, period or 'for patients' that begins the heavier or higher-value group after a 'less than' group.

modes.description: A linking word such as 'and' or 'those' placed between a '<' group and a '≥' group in a dose rule.
